label: The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings sandboxes
description: How The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: vortex.

notes: The executable is in the bin folder. The game ships userContentManager.exe for managing its own user content.
Hard links are the default: the game folder and the staging folder are almost always on one drive, and nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod.
